iLock_Geography
Package iLock_Geography :: Package predicate_library :: Module area
[frames] | no frames]

Module area

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to areas.

Classes
  ObjectInArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(obj, area)' if obj of type INSIDE_TYPE_C is inside of area of type AREA_TYPE.
  AreaInArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(area_1, area_2)' if area_1 is inside of area_2.
  AreaIntersectsArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(area_1, area_2)' if area_1 and area_2, both of type AREA_TYPE intersected with each other.
  AreaAtSignal
Predicate class that builds true point '(signal, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is before or after signal of type SIGNAL_TYPE.
  AreaAtArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(area_1, area_2)' if area_2 is before or after area_1.
  AreaAfterArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(area_1, area_2)' if area_2 is after area_1 in the positive direction.

Imports: RailyardFactory, alg, GeoPredicate, geoAssert, INSIDE_TYPE_C, AREA_TYPE, SIGNAL_TYPE, typedoc
